newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: CSFB sets buy recommendation for Gurit.
newsitem.headline: CSFB sets buy recommendation for Gurit.

text.p: Credit Suisse First Boston said it had upgraded its recommendation for Gurit-Heberlein shares to buy from hold and revised upwards its earnings forecasts.
"Based on the favourable valuation (estimated P/E ratio for 1998 of 9.2) and good profit outlook we recommend buying the shares," analyst Werner Richli said in a research report.
The chemical and plastics company's shares were trading at 3,760 Swiss francs around 1310 GMT, up 60.
CSFB revised its EPS estimate to 346 francs from 248 in 1997 and to 378 from 283 in 1998.
